domain.name: Embodied / Physical-IoT
domain.description: Software with a physical or spatial footprint — hardware pairing, proximity, ambient presence, or AR overlays on the real world.

governance.name: Quorum / Consensus
governance.description: Multiple parties — agents and/or humans — must agree before an action lands.

latency.name: Interactive (sub-second)
latency.description: Conversational, turn-based UI latency — the user waits for one reply, not a stream of frames.

pitch: A embodied / physical-iot governed by quorum / consensus, operating at interactive (sub-second) latency.
